artifacts.subject: Modern DEEP-WATER OIL RIG, a compact floating semi-submersible offshore drilling platform viewed exactly vertically above, isolated within a small bounded dark navy/teal ocean-water patch. Broad rectangular grey steel deck TOP plan with a central square dark drill-well opening and square steel derrick lattice TOP footprint over it; narrow symmetrical top beams and tiny sheave TOP circles, no upright derrick side silhouette. White-grey corrugated and flat accommodation/operations ROOF modules along west/north deck edge, small rooftop vent squares. Yellow safety walkway plan lines and yellow handrail TOP lines around deck and drill area. One round raised helipad TOP disc at north-west or left edge, perfect circular yellow ring and a single white H; no helicopter. Parallel dark drill-pipe TOP racks at east, one horizontal service-crane jib TOP over southern deck and small crate TOPs. Two narrow orange enclosed lifeboat ROOF silhouettes at outer right/lower deck edge. Four small broad column/pontoon TOP footprints at deck corners, with water surrounding them; no support legs down to seabed, no jack-up leg elevation, no shore or attached land. Detailed blue-grey deck, yellow safety accents, white cabin roofs, dark steel, orange rescue craft, dark deep-water ripples only within a compact uneven water silhouette. Entire site should occupy about 82 percent of canvas and true transparent alpha outside the narrow water patch. No oil spill, fire, giant tanker, coastal harbour, many containers, upright tower panorama, side hulls, lettering other than one helipad H. Readable as one floating deep-water platform when downsampled to 627 x 627.
artifacts.prompt:
Create ONE standalone top-down strategy-game building/resource icon on a genuine transparent background, matching the approved Age of Fronts building art in the attached reference. The reference supplies ONLY the hand-painted realistic materials, finely detailed roof textures, color balance, and strict overhead camera. Do not copy its subject, floorplan, prop layout or building type.

CAMERA AND GEOMETRY: exact vertical nadir orthographic roof-plan view, camera perpendicular to ground/deck. All circular horizontal objects are perfect circles. Pitched roofs have centered ridges and equally wide slopes; roofs entirely hide facades, doors and windows. Buildings show only their roof and rooftop details. Fences show thin plan lines with tiny post tops. Machinery is seen only from its TOP; elevated structures rise toward the viewer, not toward the top edge of the image. No vertical wall bands under roofs, no side-view towers, no foreshortened ground. All four compass edges are equally viewed from above. No isometric or oblique miniature, no frontal cutaway. Dimensional feel comes from roof slope shading, surface textures and very short subtle contact shadows.

MATERIALS / FRAMING: finely textured realistic hand-painted game illustration, rich weathered stone/wood/slate/brick/metal as appropriate, crisp silhouette, muted natural colors, restrained top-left light and tiny down-right shadows, matching the existing icon set. Square canvas. One complete bounded site occupies roughly 80-84 percent of canvas width/height with generous transparent margin on every side. Preserve all props and water/foliage within margins. True transparent alpha outside the site; no solid background, black fill, fake checkerboard, UI, text labels, decorative frame or watermark. No people. Single icon, never a multi-panel sheet.
